articles.title: Japanese visitors may be able to pay with yen stablecoins in South Korea under Shinhan-SBI pact
articles.snippet: The collaboration will explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea and peer-to-peer wallet transfers among broader cross-border trade remittances.

articles.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
articles.snippet: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

articles.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
articles.snippet: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

articles.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
articles.snippet: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: Ether ETF outflows continue, pass $1B in October so far
articles.snippet: US spot Ether ETFs have shed $1.08 billion so far in October, the biggest monthly outflow of 2026, while Bitcoin ETF inflows slowed after Monday’s spike.
